The '''2013–14 Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball team''' represented [[California State University, Fresno]] during the [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. This was head coach [[Rodney Terry]]'s third season at Fresno State. The Bulldogs played their home games at the [[Save Mart Center at Fresno State|Save Mart Center]] and they were members of the [[Mountain West Conference]]. They finished the season 21–18, 9–9 in Mountain West play to finish in a tie for fifth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2014 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament|Mountain West Conference tournament]] to New Mexico. They were invited to the [[2014 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where they advanced to the best of 3 finals where they lost to Siena 1 games to 2.
